description: Complete Python ai-service implementation with uv, pyproject.toml, FastAPI app, and comprehensive tests. Currently ai-service/ only has empty requirements.txt. Replace venv workflow with uv-managed Python 3.13, create full FastAPI service with classify_command (pattern-based risk detection), suggest_safer_alternative, extract_json, analyze_impact endpoints, add pytest tests covering all specified cases, configure CORS for localhost:5173 and 127.0.0.1:5173 only.
steps: Create ai-service/pyproject.toml: [project] name='intellishell-ai-service', version='0.1.0', requires-python='>=3.13', dependencies=['fastapi>=0.115.0', 'uvicorn[standard]>=0.32.0', 'requests>=2.32.0', 'pydantic>=2.10.0']; [build-system] requires=['hatchling'], build-backend='hatchling.build'; [tool.uv] dev-dependencies=['pytest>=8.3.0', 'ruff>=0.8.0']; [tool.ruff] line-length=100, [tool.ruff.lint] select=['E', 'F', 'I'], [tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths=['tests']
Run 'uv lock' in ai-service/ to generate uv.lock (this requires uv to be installed, which bootstrap.sh will handle — for now, create a placeholder uv.lock or accept it will be generated later)

Create ai-service/main.py with: classify_command(command: str) -> dict — pattern matching for dangerous patterns (rm -rf /, rm -rf ~, dd to /dev/sd*, fork bomb :(){:|:&};:, chmod -R 777 /, kill -9 1, shutdown/reboot/halt, curl|wget piped to bash/sh); suggest_safer_alternative(command: str) -> dict; extract_json(text: str) -> dict — handle both fenced (```json...```) and unfenced JSON; analyze_impact(command: str, context: dict) -> dict — file/directory impact analysis. FastAPI app with endpoints: POST /classify {command: str}, POST /suggest {command: str}, POST /analyze {command: str, context: dict}, GET /health. CORSMiddleware allowing origins ['http://localhost:5173', 'http://127.0.0.1:5173']. Bind uvicorn to 127.0.0.1:8000.

Create ai-service/tests/test_classify.py: test_classify_rm_rf_root, test_classify_rm_rf_home, test_classify_rm_r, test_classify_dd_to_dev, test_classify_fork_bomb, test_classify_chmod_777_recursive, test_classify_kill_init, test_classify_kill_normal_pid, test_classify_shutdown, test_classify_curl_pipe_bash, test_classify_harmless, test_suggest_safer_alternative_cases
Create ai-service/tests/test_extract.py: test_extract_json_fenced (with ```json wrapper), test_extract_json_unfenced (plain JSON), test_extract_json_invalid
Create ai-service/tests/test_analyze.py: test_analyze_impact_with_real_files (use pytest tmp_path fixture to create real files/dirs and test impact analysis)
Run 'ruff format ai-service/' (after uv installs ruff)
Run 'ruff check ai-service/' and fix any issues
Run 'pytest ai-service/tests/' and verify all tests pass
Commit: git add ai-service/ && git rm ai-service/requirements.txt && git commit -m 'feat(ai): full FastAPI service with uv, classify/suggest/extract/analyze, tests'
acceptance_criteria: ai-service/pyproject.toml exists with correct dependencies (fastapi, uvicorn, requests, pydantic) and dev-dependencies (pytest, ruff)
ai-service/main.py implements all four functions and FastAPI app with /classify, /suggest, /analyze, /health endpoints
CORS middleware allows only http://localhost:5173 and http://127.0.0.1:5173
ai-service/tests/ contains test_classify.py, test_extract.py, test_analyze.py with all specified test cases
pytest passes with all tests green
